capabilities: : Switch between rendered content and source
extras: Desktop only; read-only; no telemetry; offline KaTeX.
problem: Users need a way to view complex, text-based Mathematica notebooks (.nb) and their embedded formulas and annotations within the Obsidian environment.
summary: A read-only viewer that allows users to read Wolfram Mathematica notebooks (.nb) in Obsidian, rendering formulas with KaTeX and preserving annotations and source code.
